title: Fire Escape 3D Pathfinding with Collision
prompt:
Create a 3D fire escape pathfinding simulation using Three.js. An agent navigates a multi-floor building, avoiding spreading fire and colliding with walls. Load the collision-world.glb as the building environment. The entire application must be in a single HTML file.

## Three.js Import
Use this importmap in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

## Scene Setup
- Background 0x0d0d12.
- PerspectiveCamera at (20, 15, 20), looking at origin.
- OrbitControls enabled.
- Ambient light (0x332211, intensity 0.3) and directional light (0xff8844, intensity 0.6) at (10, 20, 5) to simulate fire glow atmosphere.
- Load 'collision-world.glb' as the environment. Scale uniformly by 0.5 and center at origin.

## Agent
- A green sphere (radius 0.3, color 0x44ff44) representing the evacuation agent.
- Start position: (5, 0.3, 5).
- Movement speed: 4 units/sec.
- The agent uses a simple waypoint-based A* pathfinding on a grid.
- Create a navigation grid: discretize the XZ plane into 0.5-unit cells over the loaded environment's bounding box. Mark cells as blocked if they overlap with the collision geometry (use raycasting downward to detect floor and walls).
- Agent follows the computed path, moving from waypoint to waypoint.

## Fire Spread
- Fire starts at position (-3, 0, -3) as 3 particle emitters with orange/red point sprites.
- Fire spreads outward at 0.3 units/sec as a growing set of affected grid cells.
- Affected cells glow red on the floor (project red semi-transparent planes at y=0.05).
- Fire-affected cells become blocked for pathfinding.
- If the agent enters a fire cell, it takes damage (health decreases by 10/sec).

## Exit Point
- An exit marker: a green glowing ring (torus, major radius 0.8, tube 0.1, emissive 0x00ff44) at position (-6, 0.1, 8) pulsing in opacity.
- When the agent reaches the exit (distance < 1.0), display 'ESCAPED!' in HUD.

## Controls
- Press 'G' to start/restart the simulation (agent begins pathfinding to exit, fire starts spreading).
- Press Space to pause/play.
- Press 'R' to reset everything (agent to start, fire cleared, path cleared).
- Slider (id='slider-fire-speed', range 0.1 to 1.0, step 0.05, default 0.3) for fire spread speed.
- Slider (id='slider-agent-speed', range 1 to 10, step 0.5, default 4) for agent movement speed.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Status (id='hud-status'): 'Idle' / 'Running' / 'Escaped' / 'Dead'
- Agent health (id='hud-health'): 0-100, integer
- Fire cells (id='hud-fire'): number of fire-affected cells
- Path length (id='hud-path'): number of waypoints in current path
- Distance to exit (id='hud-dist'): distance from agent to exit, 1 decimal
- Model loaded (id='hud-model'): 'Yes' or 'No'

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `status`: string ('Idle'|'Running'|'Escaped'|'Dead')
- `health`: number (0-100)
- `fireCellCount`: number
- `pathLength`: number
- `distToExit`: number (rounded to 2 decimals)
- `agentPosition`: {x, y, z}
- `modelLoaded`: boolean
- `isPaused`: boolean
- `fireSpeed`: number
- `agentSpeed`: number
- `frameCount`: number
- `agentValid`: boolean (no NaN in agent position)

Ensure the animation loop updates __3D_STATE__ every frame before rendering.
physics_constraints: Agent must not pass through collision geometry walls. Fire must spread outward concentrically. Agent health decreases only when in fire cells. Path must be recomputed when fire blocks current path. Agent stops at exit or when health reaches 0. No NaN positions.
